content_zh:
顿时一道妖异幽幻的声音，从玉牌上响起。
“目标持续向南偏移中，向东七百二十六、偏南九十四；命令：无面巨人、血饮军团全力追击。”
顾青山听了，顿时恍然。
这是魔军的调度密令，是指引军队行动的传令牌。
看来这怪鸟果真是魔军信使，专司传递消息和调动部队。
信使的速度极快，全力飞行的时候迅若闪电，若不是已受了重伤，顾青山肯定留不下对方。
没有这头怪鸟的情报和命令，魔军部队肯定会偏离它们所追踪的目标。
顾青山将血色玉牌掂了掂，顺手收入囊中。
没想到阴差阳错，自己居然破坏了魔军的调度。
魔鸟已死，想必能让无面巨人和饮血魔困扰一段时间。
自己修为太低，能做的只有这么多了，顾青山轻叹一声。
这样下去不行，必须尽快改变自己的处境。
力量，我需要力量！
这一刻，顾青山的眼眸充满了坚定和渴望。
洗掉身上黑泥，再去看了赵六，见对方仍旧在昏迷之中，顾青山便补充好箭矢，挎上军弓，离开了营地。
一直到傍晚时分，顾青山才拖着一只妖兽回到营地。
他其实没有去太远，只是因为修为太低，不得不将所有的隐匿本事都拿了出来，在军营周边转了转，有惊无险的躲过几头凶恶妖兽，最终猎杀了几头低等级的小型妖兽。
这些妖兽都是最低阶的存在，正适合炼气前期对付。
以他炼气二层的微弱实力，将箭袋里的箭矢全部用完，身上各处也添了些伤口，才堪堪杀掉几头。
这也不能怪他，上一世，玩家们一开始想要猎杀妖兽，无不是组成大型团队，用尽全力才能捕杀一头妖兽。

而且就算是小型妖兽，也有三四百斤重，一个普通人想要将之挪动都十分困难。
储物袋空间有限，顾青山为了保持机动性，也只取了其中一只带回来。
另外的小型妖兽被他直接放弃掉。
丛林里危机四伏，妖兽尸体上的血腥气，很快就能吸引来许多猎食者。
战神系统却对猎杀低阶妖兽十分不屑，一整个白天的猎杀，一共才给了顾青山1点魂力。
他现在一共只有4点魂力，经验值方面还不错，终于达到10点。
他可以升级了。
拖回来的那头小型妖兽，也够他和赵六吃上一段日子。
若不是隐匿法阵的灵石不够，两人倒是再多呆十数天都没有问题。
顾青山回到营地的时候，赵六已经醒了。
赵六满面绝望的呆立在军营门口，直到看见顾青山和他身后的小型妖兽尸体，整个人才重新活过来。
赵六弓着腰，眼睛直勾勾盯着那头小型妖兽，根本挪不开。
他说道：“顾兄弟，之前多谢了，你快去休息，这畜生交给我整治，晚上的饭食包你满意。”
“你拿去。”
顾青山丢下妖兽，转身回了房间，双膝一盘，闭上眼睛。
“目前经验值为1010，请问是否升级？”
“是。”
伴随着顾青山的选择，他全身气血迅速升腾起来，灵力也蠢蠢欲动，然而体内一处关卡死死堵住灵力，不允许它们通过。
能感应到关卡的存在，就说明冲破关卡的时机到了。
这是突破的契机！

顾青山顺其自然的进入了突破状态。
猛的吐出一口浊气，顾青山整个人为之一畅。
成功了，终于突破到了炼气三层境界！
顾青山立刻就收了灵力，小心的将其发散到全身经脉中，慢慢温养身体。
身上细微的伤势太多了，大意不得。
他一边用灵力温养身体，一边撇了眼界面。
“目前经验值为015。”
下一次升级，还需要继续出去猎杀。
顾青山只觉得一种前所未有的紧迫感充斥在心中。
无面巨人的实力等同元婴大圆满，是顾青山目前只能仰望的存在。
以无面巨人的实力境界，应该发现了军营，只不过军营中只有两个实力微弱的蝼蚁，无面巨人不屑出手而已。
这种生死操控于妖魔手上的感觉，实在是不妙。
顾青山来回走了几步，下了决心。
不行，必须马上练级，一直冲到筑基境才可以。
从炼气到筑基，从筑基到金丹，乃至每一个大境界的提升，都有机会领悟神通，当然也可能失败。
这个世界的神通分为四种，和真实世界完全相同，分别是武道归藏、五行超凡、天选之人以及神裔。

content_en:
Suddenly, a strange and ghostly voice sounded from the jade tablet.
"The target continues to move southward, 726 to the east and 94 to the south; order: Faceless Giant and Blood Drinking Legion to pursue with all their might."
Gu Qingshan suddenly understood after hearing this.
This is the secret dispatching order of the demonic army, and it is the messenger that guides the army's actions.
It seems that this strange bird is really the messenger of the demon army, specializing in delivering messages and mobilizing troops.
The messenger was extremely fast, flying as fast as lightning when flying at full strength. If he hadn't been seriously injured, Gu Qingshan would definitely not be able to keep him.
Without the intelligence and orders of this strange bird, the demon army's troops would definitely deviate from the target they were tracking.
Gu Qingshan weighed the blood jade token and put it into his pocket.
Unexpectedly, by mistake, he actually destroyed the arrangement of the demon army.
The demon bird is dead, and it will surely trouble the faceless giant and the blood-drinker for a while.
His cultivation level is too low, there is only so much he can do, Gu Qingshan sighed softly.
This cannot continue, and we must change our situation as soon as possible.
Power, I need power!
At this moment, Gu Qingshan's eyes were full of determination and desire.
After washing off the black mud from his body, he went to see Zhao Liu again. Seeing that he was still unconscious, Gu Qingshan replenished his arrows, picked up his military bow, and left the camp.
It was not until evening that Gu Qingshan dragged a monster back to the camp.
In fact, he didn't go too far, but because his cultivation level was too low, he had to use all his concealment skills and walked around the military camp. He narrowly escaped several vicious monsters and finally hunted down several low-level small monsters.
These monsters are the lowest level beings, and are suitable for dealing with in the early stage of Qi refining.
With his weak strength at the second level of Qi Refining, he used up all the arrows in his quiver and added some wounds on his body before he could kill a few.
This can't be blamed on him. In the last life, when players first wanted to hunt monsters, they formed a large team and used all their strength to hunt down a monster.
And even a small monster weighs three to four hundred kilograms, making it very difficult for an ordinary person to move it.
The storage bag has limited space, so in order to maintain mobility, Gu Qingshan only took one of them and brought it back.
The other small monsters were abandoned by him directly.
The jungle is full of dangers, and the bloody smell on the corpses of monsters will soon attract many predators.
The God of War system was very disdainful of hunting low-level monsters. The whole day of hunting only gave Gu Qingshan 1 point of soul power.
He only has a total of 4 soul power points now, and his experience points are pretty good, finally reaching 10 points.
He can level up.
The small monster dragged back was enough to feed him and Zhao Liu for a while.
If it weren't for the lack of spiritual stones in the concealment circle, the two of them could have stayed for another ten days without any problem.
When Gu Qingshan returned to the camp, Zhao Liu had already woken up.
Zhao Liu stood at the entrance of the military camp with a face full of despair. It was not until he saw the corpse of Gu Qingshan and the small monster behind him that he came back to life.
Zhao Liu hunched over, staring straight at the small monster beast, unable to move away at all.
He said: "Brother Gu, thank you very much. You go and have a rest. I will take care of this beast. You will be satisfied with the meal at night."
"Take it."
Gu Qingshan left the monster behind, turned around and returned to the room, crossed his knees and closed his eyes.
"The current experience value is 1010. Do you want to upgrade?"
"Yes."
Following Gu Qingshan's choice, the energy and blood in his body rose rapidly, and his spiritual power was ready to move. However, a barrier in his body blocked the spiritual power and did not allow them to pass.
If you can sense the existence of a level, it means that the time has come to break through the level.
This is your chance for a breakthrough!
Gu Qingshan let nature take its course and entered a breakthrough state.
Gu Qingshan let out a strong breath, and his whole body felt relieved.
I succeeded and finally broke through to the third level of Qi refining!
Gu Qingshan immediately collected his spiritual power and be carefulDistribute it into the meridians of the body, slowly warming and nourishing the body.
There were too many minor injuries on his body to be careless.
While using his spiritual power to warm his body, he glanced at the interface.
"The current experience value is 015."
Next time you upgrade, you need to continue hunting.
Gu Qingshan only felt an unprecedented sense of urgency filling his heart.
The strength of the faceless giant is equivalent to the Nascent Soul Dzogchen, and it is an existence that Gu Qingshan can only look up to at the moment.
With the faceless giant's level of strength, he should have discovered the military camp, but there were only two weak ants in the military camp, and the faceless giant didn't bother to take action.
This feeling of life and death being controlled by a demon is really not good.
Gu Qingshan took a few steps back and forth and made up his mind.
No, you have to level up immediately and rush to the foundation building stage.
From Qi refining to foundation building, from foundation building to golden elixir, and even at every major level of improvement, there is a chance to realize magical powers, but of course it is also possible to fail.
There are four types of magical powers in this world, which are exactly the same as in the real world. They are martial arts, extraordinary, five elements, chosen ones, and descendants of gods.
